climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A New South Wales region in the Central Ranges zone. Shiraz is 23 percent of plantings, followed by Chardonnay (18).
